title: TMS Bicycle, stable without gyros or trail (TMS=two-mass-skate)
summary: Arend Schwab demonstrates a research bicycle, the two-mass-skate design, that balances itself without gyroscopic effects or trail. It challenges the common explanations for why a moving bicycle stays upright.
why: HN commenters cite it as the author's own demonstration of research showing that bicycle stability is not explained by gyroscopes.

quote.text: Explanation of the research in question behind this article, as well as a demonstration of the bike they based the research on.
